authority.instructionVerbatim: please go ahead and do that
authority.instructionContext: The immediately preceding decision asked for the separate pilot/distribution authorization required to qualify exact Build 27 for the existing controlled pilot group, explicitly excluding public and Play Store release.
authority.scopeInterpretation: Authorize exact Build 27 for a staged, direct-custody controlled pilot of no more than 25 approved users. Preserve a two-device canary, per-handout privacy-safe receipts and immediate stop conditions. This does not authorize public, Play Store, web, GitHub Release, Firebase App Distribution or unrestricted distribution.

stagePlan.phase1: Hand exact Build 27 directly to no more than two approved users on two named physical devices. Verify hash, signer, in-place upgrade, authenticated launch, clean synchronization and one representative user-owned operation on each target.
stagePlan.phase1Observation: Observe through one normal operating shift. Any stop condition blocks further handout.
stagePlan.phase2: After both canary receipts pass, expand only to the remaining frozen approved-user and physical-device roster, keeping the total at or below 25.
stagePlan.phase2Evidence: Record a privacy-safe execution receipt for every handout and retain the exact package hash in the handout log.
stagePlan.mutatingFlowQualification: Mutating business-flow evidence may be collected during the controlled canary. It is not claimed by this approval and remains an open qualification for broader release.

stopConditions: The package, signer, source commit or governed package hash differs from the exact Build 27 authority.
An installation would require uninstalling, clearing app data or bypassing signer continuity.
A target reports a crash, ANR, repeated startup failure, authorization failure or critical-alarm feed failure.
Synchronization reports a permanent rejection, unresolved conflict, unexplained pending row, duplicate command, row loss or different users seeing irreconcilable state.
A required workflow action cannot be completed, its actor/time evidence is malformed, or a terminal obligation remains without an explained business reason.
The approved-user or physical-device roster is not frozen, exceeds 25 users or includes an unapproved user.
The APK is placed on a public link, GitHub Release, Firebase App Distribution, Play channel, web channel or another unapproved distribution path.
Production Rules, indexes, Functions, IAM, App Check posture, signing authority or recovery controls drift from admitted evidence.
